xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2568: Summary fork delivery race: large summary lands in codex composer but is never submitted; conversation looks dead

plan.title: Summary fork delivery race: large summary lands in codex composer but is never submitted; conversation looks dead
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

narratives.Problem: A summary fork into a codex conversation delivered a multi-KB summary that was never submitted: the delivery client's fixed 8s socket timeout (src/lib/agents/delivery.ts:216-219) abandoned the POST while the PTY supervisor was still echo-confirming the large paste, the tmux fallback pasted a second copy concurrently (duplicate-writer race, PAN-1769 regression), the supervisor's 8,192-char purge cap (pty-supervisor.ts:40) left a remnant in the composer, every Enter arrived inside the paste burst and became a newline, and injectForkSummary treated the unconfirmed outcome as success — leaving a healthy-looking conversation with an empty transcript and the whole summary stranded unsent in the composer.
narratives.Proposal: Make abandonment structurally impossible: one exported leaf module (src/lib/channels/injection-budget.ts) computes payload-size-aware echo/settle/purge timings and the supervisor's worst-case injection budget; the supervisor's internal waits and the delivery client's socket timeout both derive from it, client strictly greater. Raise the purge cap to 262,144 chars (reject larger payloads with 400) so purge always erases the full write. In the fork pipeline, add a pane-verified standalone-Enter recovery (up to 2 nudges via sendKeysAsync) when the runtime mirror stays silent and the delivered tail is still visible; on final failure set forkStatus='failed' with an actionable forkError instead of silently completing. PRD drafts/pan-2568.md is decision-complete; all snippets and line references verified against sha b31f1cf07e.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No generic post-delivery Enter-nudge for every deliverAgentMessage caller (e.g. conversation-message); the nudge is scoped to the fork pipeline. If stranded conversation messages recur after this lands, file a follow-up to lift the helper into delivery.ts.
- No persisting generated fork summaries to disk for replay (separate follow-up if wanted).
- No codex-side changes; paste-burst classification is upstream harness behavior we adapt to.
- No in-supervisor watchdog timer; every internal wait is already bounded by the budget functions.
- No new dependencies; supervisor remains Node-22-only.
- Do not route stranded forks through handleForkPipelineFailure / markConversationEnded — the session is alive and recoverable.

autoDecisions.summary: Adopted the PRD's work-item structure and exact timing formulas verbatim (floors 2.5s/300ms/150ms, caps 15s/2s/1s, purge cap 262,144, client margin 2s, overhead 3s).
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD is decision-complete with before/after snippets and named tests; every cited file:line was re-verified against the workspace at sha b31f1cf07e and found accurate. Re-deciding would only introduce drift.

autoDecisions.summary: Split PRD WI-4 into two beads: a tmux helper/export refactor and the fork enter-nudge recovery.
autoDecisions.rationale: The helper extraction is a pure no-behavior-change refactor reviewable in isolation; the nudge loop is the behavioral change. Smaller independently mergeable diffs.

autoDecisions.summary: Export the currently module-private capturePaneText from src/lib/tmux.ts:694 for the fork recovery, instead of using the Effect-based capturePane wrapper.
autoDecisions.rationale: injectForkSummary is plain async/await and the PRD snippets call capturePaneText directly; adding the export keyword is the smallest change. Verified capturePaneText is not currently exported.

autoDecisions.summary: parsePayload rejects content longer than INPUT_PURGE_MAX_CHARS with a 400 rather than truncating.
autoDecisions.rationale: PRD states this explicitly: 'accepted' must always imply 'purgeable'; no caller sends megabyte messages today, so rejecting is correct and silent truncation is not.

autoDecisions.summary: Documentation targets are CLAUDE.md (PTY supervisor section), src/lib/channels/SMOKE_TEST.md, and module headers only — no Mintlify page.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD states this judgment deliberately: delivery internals are developer docs with no user-facing configuration surface.

items.title: Shared payload-size-aware injection-budget module wired into supervisor and delivery client

expected_outputs: injection-budget.test.ts passes (monotonicity, floors, caps, client-exceeds-budget property)
git grep for 8_000 in delivery.ts prints nothing

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/channels/injection-budget.ts as a leaf module (imports nothing from src/lib) exporting INPUT_ECHO_CONFIRM_INTERVAL_MS=50, INPUT_ECHO_CONFIRM_ATTEMPTS=2, INPUT_ECHO_CONFIRM_PREFIX_CHARS=40, INPUT_PURGE_MAX_CHARS=262_144, SUPERVISOR_CLIENT_MARGIN_MS=2_000, and the functions echoConfirmTimeoutMs(len)=min(2_500+ceil(len/1024)*100, 15_000), inputSettleMs(len)=min(300+ceil(len/1024)*50, 2_000), purgeSettleMs(erased)=min(150+ceil(erased/1024)*25, 1_000), supervisorInjectionBudgetMs(len)=ATTEMPTS*echoConfirmTimeoutMs(len)+ATTEMPTS*purgeSettleMs(min(len,INPUT_PURGE_MAX_CHARS))+inputSettleMs(len)+3_000 (INJECTION_OVERHEAD_MS, module-private). Exact code is in PRD WI-1. In src/lib/agents/delivery.ts replace the hardcoded 8_000 socket POST timeout (currently :216-219) with supervisorInjectionBudgetMs(message.length)+SUPERVISOR_CLIENT_MARGIN_MS and update the comment per the PRD. In src/lib/channels/pty-supervisor.ts import the shared constants/functions and delete the local INPUT_ECHO_CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_MS, INPUT_SETTLE_MS, INPUT_PURGE_SETTLE_MS, and INPUT_PURGE_MAX_CHARS=8_192 (:35-41); any log line that interpolated a deleted constant name interpolates the computed value instead. No in-supervisor watchdog timer. Write src/lib/channels/__tests__/injection-budget.test.ts per PRD WI-1's named assertions.

narrative.Action: In src/lib/channels/pty-supervisor.ts: purgePtyInput (:265) keeps `Math.min(charCount, INPUT_PURGE_MAX_CHARS) + 8` but the cap is now the shared 262,144 from injection-budget, and the fixed `sleep(INPUT_PURGE_SETTLE_MS)` becomes `sleep(purgeSettleMs(count))`. parsePayload (:108) rejects content longer than INPUT_PURGE_MAX_CHARS so the injection endpoint responds 400 — 'accepted' always implies 'purgeable'; do NOT silently truncate. Update the doc comment above purgePtyInput: the PAN-1769 invariant (retries never stack duplicate copies) now explicitly holds for payloads up to INPUT_PURGE_MAX_CHARS. Note MAX_REQUEST_BYTES=1 MiB (:34) already bounds the HTTP body above the new cap; leave it unchanged.

narrative.Action: In src/lib/overdeck/conversation-forks.ts, change injectForkSummary (:320) to return Promise<'submitted' | 'stranded'> (today Promise<void>; the ohmypi early-return branch near :324-328 returns 'submitted'). After each deliverAgentMessage + confirmForkPromptAccepted cycle that does not return 'accepted' (i.e. on BOTH 'still-idle' and 'unknown' — the incident case was 'unknown', so the current unknown→return branch near :338-341 is replaced by this recovery): compute verify = deliveryVerifyLine(summary).slice(0,40); loop up to 2 nudges: capture the pane via capturePaneText(conv.tmuxSession, 40); if verify (length ≥3) is NOT in the pane, break (composer empty — fall through to the existing attempt-2 re-delivery loop); otherwise warn and send a lone C-m via sendKeysAsync(conv.tmuxSession, 'C-m', `${caller}:enter-nudge`), then confirmForkPromptAccepted(conv.tmuxSession, 8000) — 'accepted' returns 'submitted'; also re-capture and if the verify line is gone return 'submitted' (composer cleared; codex mirror may lag). A nudge cycle that finds the composer still full and fails both Enters returns 'stranded' WITHOUT re-delivering (re-pasting onto a full composer is exactly how duplicates happen); the existing 'could not confirm brief delivery after 2 attempts' path also returns 'stranded'. Exact snippet in PRD WI-4 step 2. New test file src/lib/overdeck/__tests__/conversation-forks-enter-nudge.test.ts with fake timers, mocking capturePaneText, sendKeysAsync, and forkPipelineRuntimeOverrides.getAgentRuntimeStateSync. Only async tmux primitives.

items.title: Given the composer still shows the verify line and the runtime mirror is idle, injectForkSummary sends exactly one standalone C-m and returns 'submitted' when confirmForkPromptAccepted then reports 'accepted'

Given both nudges fail with the composer still full, injectForkSummary returns 'stranded' and never re-delivers the summary (deliverAgentMessage not called again after the nudge loop)
The recovery emits at most 2 standalone C-m keystrokes per injection attempt, all via sendKeysAsync (no sync sendKeys, no execSync)
Stranded forks set forkStatus='failed' with an actionable error instead of silently completing

narrative.Action: In runForkPipeline (src/lib/overdeck/conversation-forks.ts:357; injection call currently `await self.injectForkSummary(...)` at :491 followed by unconditional `updateForkStatus(convName, null)` at :493): capture the injection result; if 'stranded', call updateForkStatus(convName, 'failed', 'Summary was delivered to the terminal but never submitted. Open the Terminal tab and press Enter to submit it; the session is alive.') and return; otherwise clear forkStatus to null as today. Do NOT route the stranded case through handleForkPipelineFailure (:350) — it calls markConversationEnded, which is wrong because the successor session is alive and one keystroke recovers it. Exact snippet in PRD WI-5. Extend the enter-nudge test file with the forkStatus assertions.
